title: Mavromatis & Karypis: Graph-Based Reasoning and Retrieval for LLMs
summary: This community centers on the research contributions of Costas Mavromatis and George Karypis, who have co-authored two significant works in the intersection of knowledge graphs and large language models. The group links the 2022 paper 'ReaRev,' published at EMNLP Findings, with the 2024 paper 'GNN-RAG,' which extends their work to graph neural retrieval for LLM reasoning. These entities form a cohesive cluster representing a specific research trajectory in adaptive reasoning and graph-enhanced retrieval.
key_findings: Costas Mavromatis and George Karypis are the sole authors listed for both 'ReaRev' and 'GNN-RAG' in the provided data.
'ReaRev: Adaptive Reasoning for Question Answering over Knowledge Graphs' was published in the Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2022.
'GNN-RAG: Graph Neural Retrieval for Large Language Model Reasoning' is a 2024 paper that proposes a method for LLM reasoning using graph neural retrieval.

The community explicitly connects the 2022 work on adaptive reasoning for QA over knowledge graphs with the 2024 work on graph neural retrieval for LLMs, suggesting a thematic continuity in the authors' research.
The publication venue for ReaRev is specifically identified as the Findings track of EMNLP 2022, held in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.
